Singh Resident of village- Madanpur, PS- Pandarak Old, New PS- NTPC  Barh, District- Patna
... ... Pe  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Pushpa Devi D/o Late Alakhdeo Singh, W/o Bipin Singh @ Bipin Kumar  Singh

R/o vill - Madanpur, P.S.- Pandarak (Old), New P.s. - N.T.P.C., B  Distt.- Patna, at present R/o vill - Ratna, P.S.- Chhabilapur, Distt.- 
 ... ... Respondent/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :

For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Arun Kumar Arun, Adv.
 Mr. Karamchand Kumar, Adv.
 Mr. Anil Kumar, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr.Sanjay Kumar Sharma, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 5 04-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
02. There is no representation on behalf of the opposite party no. 2 though she has been validly served as it appears from the office note.

03. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was convicted for the offences under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code in Complaint Case No. 715 C/2007, Trial No.
116/2016.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment of two years with fine of Rs. 5000/- and in default Patna High Court CR.

REV. 
No.447 of 2025(5) dt.04-11-2025 of payment of fine, the petitioner was to undergo simple imprisonment for a period of three months by the orders of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Bihar Sharif (Nalanda) and the said judgment and order of the learned trial court Bipin Singh @ Bipin Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138855802/
1 dated 21.01.2016 was upheld by the learned Appellate Court of District and Additional Sessions Judge-II, Nalanda at Bihar Sharif vide its judgment and order dated 10.01.2025.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Bihar Sharif (Nalanda)
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Bipin Singh @ Bipin Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Pursuant to the order of the Appellate Court, the petitioner surrendered on 22.04.2025 and since then he is in custody.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that if this Court intends to wait for the appearance of the opposite party no. 2, the petitioner may be admitted to provisional bail after suspending his sentence and the fine imposed.

04. Since the petitioner is already in custody for more than six months, let the petitioner be released on provisional bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Bihar Sharif (Nalanda)/concerned court, in connection with Complaint Case No. 715 C/2007, Trial No. 116/2016.
05.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Bihar Sharif (Nalanda)/concerned
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The order of sentence and payment of fine shall Patna High Court CR. REV. No.447 of 2025(5)
dt.04-11-2025 remain stayed till further orders.

06. List this case on 22.12.2025.
(Arun Kumar Jha, J) Anuradha/-
